votes.quote: on motion by rudd and second by fortin the minutes were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the requested variances for 146 Youngs Road with condition that water testing be completed before Certificate of Compliance issuance
votes.quote: motion made by fortin and second by jewell to approve the vari ances with the condition that a water test be completed prior to the issuance of a certificate of compliance. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve deed restriction for 222 West Townsend Road for 4 bedrooms with 11 total rooms
votes.quote: after discussion and motion by rudd and second by jewell, the request was approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve letter request process for approval of IA (Innovative) Septic Systems
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by rudd and second by fortin, the board approved a letter request for the approval of an ia system. all in favor.

votes.motion: Elect Matt Proctor as Chairman, Perry Jewell as Vice Chairman, and Paul Fortin as Secretary
votes.quote: on motion by rudd and second by pirro, the above were elected. all in favor.

topics.topic: 146 Youngs Road septic system replacement with variances

topics.topic: Local variance requirement for IA (Innovative) Septic Systems
topics.quote: the town of lunenburg has a local variance requirement for all ia systems . this variance has been in place for a considerable amount of time. all of the innovative systems are approved by dep, some of which have become a standard for septic installation
